correctness.rationale: For finite n, summing the column equations x_i+e_i+h_i=y_i+2h_{i+1} leaves s₂(n+t)−s₂(n)=3−Σh_{i+1}, since h₀ and the sufficiently high carry vanish. Four outgoing carries rule out success. If a carry is still outgoing at B+3, where B is the highest one of t, then it had to survive B and the three consecutive zero columns above B. Those four carries are too many, so reading B+4 low digits decides success exactly and gives a natural density by periodicity. The same argument after an internal one followed by three zeros shows that each additional zero before the next one only contributes a free input digit: it cannot change the carry, or the success fraction. This proves each gap clips at 4 for every positive shift in scope, including both gaps unbounded. Leading lower zero digits add no carries, giving c_{2t}=c_t. My replay enumerated prescribed supports of 0–3 outgoing carries (checking column-by-column compatibility and counting the corresponding input bits) and separately counted digit sums over the true residue period for each of the 16 cases. The table scaled by 64 was (43,38,41,42); (38,40,40,41); (41,40,40,41); (42,41,41,42). The only minimal actual gaps are (1,2),(2,1), not clipped large-gap cells, giving precisely the two doubling families and F(3)=3/32.
residual_risks: The extra wider-gap runs are corroboration, not the proof of saturation. The certified table is for weight three, not higher weights.

value.rationale: The fixed-Hamming-weight extremal question was already posed for a natural digit-sum correlation. Weight three is a meaningful small layer with two interacting gaps; the classification shows that neither full adjacency nor full separation minimizes the bias. A sharp lower bound with all minimizers and an exact saturation scale is useful for comparing small-weight mechanisms and for benchmarking fixed-weight estimates. At the recorded frozen date the inspected earlier recurrences alone did not give the required reduction from unbounded shifts; the later all-weight theorem now supplies a broader route.
residual_risks: No stronger Cusick bound for arbitrary Hamming weight is established by this record; later work limits present-day distinctness of the broad idea.
